sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by non-permeabilized anti-FLAG (clone 1E6) staining followed by Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody on intact HEK293 cells; no ligand-binding or signaling assay reported in the cited clips.
sites.rationale: QRFPR has no endogenous signal peptide (topology residues 1–45 are extracellular); the exogenous HA signal peptide drives membrane insertion and is cleaved, placing the FLAG epitope at the extracellular face before M1 (insert_after_residue = 0). L4 gives the exact construct sequence pinning the junction, and L5 independently confirms surface accessibility of the FLAG tag by non-permeabilized immunostaining. The insert point is 46 residues from the TM1 boundary (residue 46), well exceeding the ≥3-residue clearance requirement. L1 and L3 corroborate the same N-terminal position in independent structural-biology constructs. Full-length human QRFPR (Q96P65, no endogenous signal peptide) was expressed in HEK293 cells from a pCAGGS vector carrying an exogenous HA signal peptide (MKTIIALSYIFCLVFA) followed immediately by the FLAG epitope (DYKDDDDK) and a flexible GS linker, then QRFPR from M1. The HA signal peptide is cleaved co-translationally, leaving FLAG at the extracellular N-terminus before residue M1.

sources.claim: Specifically, GPR103 was N-terminally modified with an HA signal sequence followed by a FLAG epitope and then a flexible linker (MKTIIALSYIFCLVFA DYKDDDDK GGSGGGGSGGSSSGGG; the FLAG epitope is underlined) and inserted into the pCAGGS vector.

literature_notes: L1 (FLAG-BRIL-QRFPR-LgBiT-H8 in Hi5 insect cells) and L2 (BRIL-QRFPR-8×His in baculovirus) both place a tag at the same N-terminal prepend position (insert_after_residue = 0) but are cryo-EM structural constructs; the BRIL domain is a large thermostabilized apocytochrome b562RIL, not a short epitope tag, so these clips reinforce the position but L4/L5 are the primary surface-tag evidence. L3 describes the same FLAG-at-N-terminus construct as L4 in the context of FLAG affinity purification for structural work; L5 is the explicit surface-detection validation. The C-terminal LgBiT (L1, L3) and 8×His (L2) tags are at residue 431, which falls within the intracellular C-tail (topology 336–431) and are recorded in other_positions. No internal extracellular loop insertions are supported by any ledger line.

literature_other_positions.note: LgBiT (L1, L3) and 8×His (L2) fused after residue 431 (H); the C-terminus of QRFPR lies within the intracellular domain (topology 336–431) and is not accessible on the extracellular face.
